name: Red Pearl Pirates
detailed_description:
Chart your course across a war-torn galaxy in Red Pearl Pirate, a unique blend of epic real-time space strategy and deep, turn-based galactic conquest.

The legendary Red Pearl, an artifact of immense power, has been shattered. As the captain of the Red Pearl Pirates, you must scour the galaxy to find its fragments. This is your only hope to unite the free systems, build a corsair armada, and lead a grand rebellion against the oppressive might of the Z-Army.

Red Pearl Pirate features a dual-layer campaign where every decision matters. On the Campaign Map, you will manage resources, engage in diplomacy with a dozen other factions, build up your star systems, and strategically move your fleets. Forge alliances, threaten rivals, or even incite wars between your enemies to gain the upper hand.

When fleets clash, the action transitions to a thrilling real-time battle. Command thousands of ships in spectacular 3D combat inspired by classic naval warfare. Arrange your fleet into tactical formations like the Battle Line or the Spearhead, execute complex maneuvers, and unleash devastating broadsides to send your enemies to a watery (zero-g) grave.

Will you become a legendary pirate captain, a cunning diplomat, or a ruthless conqueror? The fate of the galaxy is in your hands. Hoist the colors and set sail for adventure!

Key Features

  • Two Games in One: Experience a deep, turn-based 4X-style campaign of galactic conquest seamlessly integrated with intense, real-time tactical space battles.

  • Command Epic-Scale Fleets: Lead armadas of up to 10,000 ships into battle. A multi-threaded simulation ensures that the action is always massive and smooth.

  • Deep Tactical Combat: Utilize classic naval-inspired strategies in a 3D space environment. Control fleet formations, execute broadside attacks, and maneuver your ships on multiple vertical levels to outwit your foes.

  • Engaging Story Campaign: Embark on the Red Pearl quest to unite the galaxy against the formidable Z-Army. Discover the artifact's power and rally factions to your cause.

  • Build Your Empire: Conquer star systems, manage your economy with credits and diplomacy points, and construct system upgrades like fortresses, trade hubs, and advanced shipyards.

  • Dynamic Diplomacy: Navigate a complex political landscape with over a dozen unique AI factions. Your actions will shape your relationships—form defensive pacts, threaten your neighbors, or manipulate factions into attacking each other.

  • Unlimited Skirmish Mode: Jump straight into the action! Set up custom battles by defining fleet sizes, AI difficulty, map types (from Open Void to Asteroid Graveyards), and victory conditions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core Processor, 2.4 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGL 1.0 Compatible Graphics Card
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Onboard Audio
  • Additional Notes: Requires a modern, up-to-date web browser such as Chrome, Firefox, or Edge. Game performance is highly dependent on browser performance
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Quad Core Processor, 3.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated Graphics Card with 2 GB+ of VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Onboard Audio
  • Additional Notes: A 64-bit browser is recommended for optimal performance, especially in large battles. Disabling other resource-heavy browser tabs will improve the experience.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04+, SteamOS 3+ (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core Processor, 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics card with 2GB VRAM (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 360)
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Onboard Audio
  • Additional Notes: Requires graphics drivers with up-to-date support for OpenGL 4.5+.
